title: 처음 해 봤어요: 경험을 말하는 낱말
objective: By the end, you can use words like 처음, 한 번, 가끔, 자주 and 가 보다 to say in short sentences whether, how often, and how many times you have done something.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for talking about what you have done before, how often, and for the first time.

task.title: Talk about your experiences
task.line: Choose a word, fill in the blank, or answer in Korean using the words on page 1.

words.meaning: experience (something you did or lived through)
words.exampleMeaning: I had a lot of good experiences in Korea.

words.meaning: the first time; for the first time
words.exampleMeaning: This is my first time in Korea.

words.meaning: time(s), used with a number word: 한 번 (once), 두 번 (twice), 세 번 (three times)
words.exampleMeaning: I watched that movie three times.
I sometimes go hiking on weekends.
I come to this café often.

words.meaning: before, at some time in the past
yet; with 안, it means 'not yet'
words.exampleMeaning: I haven't been to Busan yet.

words.example: 그 식당에 꼭 다시 가고 싶어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I really want to go to that restaurant again.

words.meaning: to go somewhere to see it; 가 봤어요 means 'have been to'
words.exampleMeaning: Have you been to Gyeongbokgung Palace?

words.meaning: to try eating; 먹어 봤어요 means 'have tried (a food)'
words.exampleMeaning: I tried spicy tteokbokki for the first time.

exercises: Choose the right word: 저는 매일 아침 커피를 마셔요. 커피를 ( 자주 / 가끔 ) 마셔요.
Fill in the blank with a number word ("I have been to Japan twice"): 일본에 ____ 번 가 봤어요.
Fill in the blank with 처음 or 다시: ① 저는 스키를 한 번도 안 타 봤어요. 어제 ____ 탔어요. 정말 무서웠어요. ② 그 식당 음식이 맛있었어요. 내일 ____ 갈 거예요.
Choose the right word: 한 달에 한 번 영화관에 가요. 영화관에 ( 가끔 / 자주 ) 가요.
Fill in the blank with 전에 or 경험: ① 지금은 회사원이에요. ____ 선생님이었어요. ② 여행은 좋은 ____이에요.
Answer in Korean: ① 한강에 가 봤어요? (No, not yet.) ② 떡국을 먹어 봤어요? (Yes, once.)
answers: ① 아니요, 아직 안 가 봤어요. ② 네, 한 번 먹어 봤어요.
